pages.ld_description:
The individual cappuccino cups simply need a splash of water to ignite the magic and reveal the Hello Kitty squishy within.
With eight different characters to collect, the simple reveal adds a magical element to the kawaii-style collectible.
Kids are delighted as they watch the squishable, scented Hello Kitty character pop up from the colourful coffee cup.
